changelog:
Initial release of character-consistency.

- Enables generating new images of a character, person, or product with strong identity consistency across poses, scenes, and styles.
- Guides users to anchor prompts to reference images, specifying only the changes (scene, pose, outfit, etc.).
- Supports up to 14 reference images for maximum fidelity with the Google Nano Banana 2 model.
- Includes workflow steps for holding identity and handling multi-image sets (e.g., expression or outfit sheets).
- Distinguishes identity consistency from pose/composition controls and multi-element scenes, referring to related skills.
summary: Keep the same character, person, or product looking identical across new scenes, poses, outfits, and styles. Use when the user says "the same character again...
